head.citation-title: Study on the horizontal dynamic characteristics of cement-soil composite pipe Piles: Field test and finite element analysis
head.abstracts: © 2025 Elsevier Ltd.This study aims to investigate the dynamic responses of cement-soil composite (CSC) pipe piles under horizontal dynamic loading through field test and finite element analysis. Firstly, the field horizontal excitation test was conducted to comparatively analyze the horizontal dynamic behaviors of a prestressed high-strength concrete (PHC) pipe pile before and after reinforcement with a cement-soil (CS) pile. Secondly, based on the results from the field test, a dynamic finite element analysis was conducted to investigate the influence mechanism of reinforcement depth, reinforcement thickness and elastic modulus of CS piles on the horizontal dynamic bearing behaviors of pipe piles. The results demonstrate that, compared to PHC pipe piles, the CSC pipe piles exhibit a significant reduction in the amplitude of horizontal acceleration and displacement at the pile head, along with an effective enhancement of horizontal dynamic design parameters. Increasing the reinforcement depth, reinforcement thickness and elastic modulus of CS piles can enhance the shear stiffness and bending stiffness of the pipe pile to different degrees. The effects of the reinforcement thickness and elastic modulus of CS piles are particularly significant.

coredata.dc:description: This study aims to investigate the dynamic responses of cement-soil composite (CSC) pipe piles under horizontal dynamic loading through field test and finite element analysis. Firstly, the field horizontal excitation test was conducted to comparatively analyze the horizontal dynamic behaviors of a prestressed high-strength concrete (PHC) pipe pile before and after reinforcement with a cement-soil (CS) pile. Secondly, based on the results from the field test, a dynamic finite element analysis was conducted to investigate the influence mechanism of reinforcement depth, reinforcement thickness and elastic modulus of CS piles on the horizontal dynamic bearing behaviors of pipe piles. The results demonstrate that, compared to PHC pipe piles, the CSC pipe piles exhibit a significant reduction in the amplitude of horizontal acceleration and displacement at the pile head, along with an effective enhancement of horizontal dynamic design parameters. Increasing the reinforcement depth, reinforcement thickness and elastic modulus of CS piles can enhance the shear stiffness and bending stiffness of the pipe pile to different degrees. The effects of the reinforcement thickness and elastic modulus of CS piles are particularly significant.
coredata.dc:title: Study on the horizontal dynamic characteristics of cement-soil composite pipe Piles: Field test and finite element analysis
